outcome_summary: Delivered the insights-audit-persona skill and a complete skills build pipeline for the ai-insights workspace, including scripts/build-skills.js (custom TargetRegistry API), scripts/publish-skills.js (stem-scoped deploy), and CLI integration via build-skills/publish-skills commands. All 4 work packages and 17 pipeline stages passed with zero test regressions (84 workspace + 3353 MCP server tests). A blocking bug in WP-003 (skills directory accidentally added to getPublishLocations(), causing clean-agents scope pollution) was caught by code review and fixed in a single rework cycle.
